title: Backup reports and alerts
learningObjective: Configure Backup reports with Log Analytics and set up and interpret Azure Monitor alerts for backup and Site Recovery.
foundation: Backup reports show trends: job success rates, backed-up items, storage used and policy compliance across vaults and subscriptions.
Alerts tell you immediately when a backup or restore job fails.
engineer: Reports: configure a diagnostic setting on each vault to send backup data (resource-specific mode tables such as AddonAzureBackupJobs, CoreAzureBackup) to a Log Analytics workspace; use Azure Policy to apply this at scale. Then open Backup reports in Business continuity center (or the vault): Summary, Backup items, Usage, Jobs, Policies, Optimize. Data can take up to 24 hours to appear initially.

Alerts: Azure Monitor built-in alerts for Azure Backup (for example backup job failures, security events like soft-deleted data) are raised automatically; route notifications with alert processing rules to action groups. Classic backup alerts have been replaced. You can also create log search alerts on the backup tables for custom conditions.
Site Recovery health and job alerts are also available through Azure Monitor alerts.
Backup jobs view in the vault shows per-job status and error codes with recommended actions.

example.title: Weekly compliance
body: An Azure Policy deploys vault diagnostic settings to law-backup. The weekly Backup report shows 98.7% job success; two failures were paged immediately through an alert processing rule to the backup team's action group.

prerequisites: An Azure subscription with VMs to monitor or protect
permissions: Monitoring Contributor (alerts, diagnostic settings) or Backup Contributor (vaults, policies)
limits: See Azure Monitor / Azure Backup service limits
portal: Vault > Diagnostic settings > + Add: choose the Azure Backup categories, resource-specific destination table, workspace.
Business continuity center > Reports (or vault > Backup reports): select workspaces.
Monitor > Alerts > Alert processing rules: scope the vaults, add action group.
configuration.cli:
az monitor diagnostic-settings create -n backup-to-law --resource $VAULT_ID --workspace law-backup --export-to-resource-specific true --logs '[{"category":"CoreAzureBackup","enabled":true},{"category":"AddonAzureBackupJobs","enabled":true},{"category":"AddonAzureBackupPolicy","enabled":true}]'
az monitor alert-processing-rule create -g rg-bkp -n route-backup --scopes $VAULT_ID --rule-type AddActionGroups --action-groups $AG_ID

steps.label: Silent failures
steps.title: Backups have been failing for a month
body: Nobody noticed until a restore was needed. Backups must be checked automatically.

steps.label: Alerts
steps.title: Built-in alerts
body: Azure Backup raises Azure Monitor alerts for problems such as job failures, security events (like deleting backup data) and more. They appear under Alerts in the vault and in Business Continuity Center.

steps.label: Notify
steps.title: Send them somewhere
body: Create an alert processing rule that routes backup alerts to an action group (email, SMS, ITSM, Logic App). Without that, alerts are only visible in the portal.

callout.text: Configure notification routing yourself: alerts do not email anyone by default.

steps.label: Reports
steps.title: Reports need data in Log Analytics
body: Add a diagnostic setting on each vault that sends backup data (resource-specific tables) to a Log Analytics workspace. Backup reports then work across vaults, subscriptions and tenants.

steps.label: Content
steps.title: What reports show
body: Backup items, job success and failure trends, policy adherence, usage and billed storage, and optimisation tips such as inactive resources or retention you could reduce. Data can take up to 24 hours to appear.

steps.label: Recap
steps.title: Backup monitoring
body: Alerts for now; reports for trends.

handsOn.title: Send vault data to Log Analytics and route backup alerts
handsOn.cost: Free or cents for a little Log Analytics data.
before: Signed in at portal.azure.com as Owner of a subscription (a free or pay-as-you-go account works). Work in a resource group called rg-az104-lab.
If rg-az104-lab does not exist yet: search 'Resource groups' > Create > name rg-az104-lab, region UAE North (or any region near you) > Review + create > Create.
rsv-lab (from the vaults lab) and a Log Analytics workspace law-lab in the same region (create one if needed).

steps.do: Open rsv-lab > Monitoring > Diagnostic settings > + Add diagnostic setting. Name diag-backup, tick the Azure Backup report categories (CoreAzureBackup, AddonAzureBackupJobs, AddonAzureBackupPolicy, AddonAzureBackupStorage, AddonAzureBackupProtectedInstance), destination law-lab, destination table: Resource specific. Save.
Search 'Business Continuity Center' (or 'Backup center') > Monitoring + Reporting > Reports (Backup reports). Select law-lab as the workspace.
steps.see: Report tabs: Summary, Backup items, Usage, Jobs, Policies, Optimize. Data appears within 24 hours of activity.
Built-in backup alerts (empty if nothing failed).

steps.do: Monitor > Alerts > Alert processing rules > + Create. Scope: rsv-lab. Filter: Monitor service = Azure Backup. Rule type: Apply action group, choose ag-lab (or create one with your email). Name apr-backup. Create.
steps.see: apr-backup listed. Future backup alerts will email you.

check: The vault sends data to law-lab and backup alerts are routed to email.
cleanup: When you finish for the day: Resource groups > rg-az104-lab > Delete resource group > type the name > Delete. This removes everything inside it.
